messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: DT v0.2 release candidate
parts:
Hi all,

It has been more than one year since the last CRAN release of DT, and
we have received a lot of requests on a new CRAN release. Now we have
a release candidate ready for you to test:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/DT')

There have been a lot of changes in the DataTables library (most
notable one is the removal of the TableTools and ColVis extensions).
Please read the package NEWS for all changes:
https://github.com/rstudio/DT/blob/master/NEWS.md

I understand there are still a few bugs and features requests that
have not been processed yet, but we'd prefer not delaying the CRAN
release any further, so we will come back to these issues after the
release. Thanks for your understanding, and any feedback will be
welcome!

Regards,
Yihui
